article_content: Steve Bruce is working to finalize the signing of left-back Andrew Robertson from Dundee United before tonight's deadline for Hull City's Europa League squad registration. The clubs have agreed on a £3m transfer fee, but personal terms with the player remain unresolved. Bruce must submit his squad list for Thursday's Europa League match against Slovak side Trencin by midnight. This match will mark Bruce's 100th game as Hull manager and the club's first-ever European fixture. Hull qualified for the Europa League as FA Cup runners-up after Arsenal, who won the cup, had already secured Champions League qualification through their league position.

article_content: The United States is intensifying efforts to broker a humanitarian pause in Israel's Gaza bombardment, as Palestinian authorities reported escalating casualties. Secretary of State Antony Blinken met with Arab leaders in Jordan on Saturday following discussions with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who maintains no cease-fire will occur until Hamas releases all hostages. President Biden indicated progress toward temporary relief measures. According to Gaza's Hamas-run Health Ministry, Palestinian fatalities have reached 9,448, including 3,900 children. Over 140 Palestinians have died in West Bank clashes. The UNRWA confirms 72 staff members killed. Israel reports 1,400 deaths, mostly from Hamas' October 7 attack that initiated hostilities and resulted in 240 hostages being taken. Approximately 1,100 individuals evacuated Gaza via the Rafah crossing through a U.S.-mediated arrangement. Reports indicate Israel has returned thousands of Palestinian workers to the conflict zone. A U.N. official states Gaza residents now survive on two bread pieces daily. Global protests erupted from Washington to Berlin demanding an immediate cease-fire. In Tel Aviv, hostage families demonstrated outside Netanyahu's residence, while Jordanian and Egyptian leaders urged enhanced civilian protections. The U.S. deployed additional naval forces to deter regional escalation. Medical infrastructure nears collapse with 16 Gaza hospitals non-operational. An Israeli strike near Al-Quds hospital injured 21 displaced persons Saturday. Rescue teams described harrowing scenes in Jabaliya refugee camp following airstrikes, with civilians extracted from rubble using makeshift stretchers.

article_content: Theodore 'Dutch' VanKirk, the final surviving crew member from the historic Enola Gay mission that altered the course of World War II, passed away at 93 in Georgia. As navigator of the B-29 Superfortress that delivered the 'Little Boy' atomic bomb to Hiroshima on August 6, 1945, VanKirk later became an advocate for nuclear disarmament despite his pivotal role in the mission. The bombing resulted in approximately 140,000 immediate deaths in Hiroshima, followed by 80,000 more in Nagasaki three days later. VanKirk's son Tom remembered his father as both a dedicated family man and someone who grappled with the moral implications of his wartime actions. 'While history books may label him a hero, to us he was simply an amazing dad who stayed vibrant until his final days,' Tom shared with the Associated Press. In later interviews, VanKirk expressed his belief that atomic weapons ultimately fail to resolve conflicts, advocating strongly for their elimination. The veteran's funeral will take place August 5 in Northumberland, Pennsylvania, where he'll be laid to rest beside his late wife. The Enola Gay, now preserved as a historical artifact, remains a powerful symbol of warfare's evolution and its lasting human consequences.
translated_content: 広島への原子爆弾投下任務に参加したエノラ・ゲイ搭乗員最後の生存者、セオドア・'ダッチ'・ヴァンカーク氏が93歳で死去しました。1945年8月6日、B-29スーパーフォートレス爆撃機の航法士として『リトルボーイ』原爆投下任務を遂行した同氏は、後に核兵器廃絶を主張するようになりました。この歴史的作戦は第二次世界大戦終結のきっかけとなりましたが、広島では約14万人、その3日後の長崎では8万人が即死する結果となりました。 息子のトム・ヴァンカーク氏はAP通信の取材で『父は歴史的には英雄とされますが、家族にとっては最期まで活力に満ちた普通の父親でした』と述べています。ヴァンカーク氏自身も2005年のインタビューにおいて、原子爆弾が紛争解決の手段になり得ないとの見解を示し、核廃絶を強く訴えていました。 葬儀は8月5日、ペンシルベニア州ノーサンバーランドで行われ、1975年に他界した妻の隣に埋葬されます。現在は歴史的遺産として保存されているエノラ・ゲイは、戦争の変遷とその人的犠牲を象徴する存在となっています。
